newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Copper looks higher, aluminium stable.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Copper looks higher, aluminium stable.

text.p: 3 MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
An upside chart close and an expected fall in LME copper stocks may spark a further upside test towards $2,550 resistance, traders and analyst said on Thursday.
Aluminium is expected to consolidate but should also find support from uptrending charts which may lead an attack on $1,650 resistance, they added.
COPPER - Seen eyeing higher levels towards $2,550 resistance against the backdrop of an expected LME stocks fall and constructive chart patterns.
"A good performance on the metal which has closed near the highs suggesting further strength underpinned by the technical indicators extending higher," Martin Squires of Rudolf Wolff said.
Squires pegged resistance at $2,540/50 and $2,580.
Several other market analyst were also targeting resistance at $2,550.

Harry Creates of AMT said if uptrend resistance at $2,550 is breached rallies to $2,570 and higher are possible. LME brokers Brandeis said $2,550 was next resistance and placed key support at $2,500. Further support was seen at $2,480, traders said.
On the charts traders and analyst noted that the 14-day RSI at 76 was still in overbought territory, although this was below its recent peak of 80 percent.
The over-extended indicator suggests that prices could be due for a pullback or at least a period of consolidation, a trader said.
At 0640 GMT three months LME copper was quoted at $2,531/35, against Wednesday's late London close of $2,533/35.
ALUMINIUM - May move to test resistance at $1,650 following a upside chart close on Wednesday.
"A positive close on the chart, although we expect further consolidation in a range between support around $1,625/30 and resistance at $1,650," Brandeis said.
Squires of Wolff pegged further resistance levels at $1,665/74 and $1,680, while Creates of AMT has the mid-May downtrend resistance at $1,659.
Support levels were pegged at $1,630, $1,610 and $1,600.
At 0640 GMT three months aluminium was quoted at $1,642/47, versus $1,643/45.
